sql: with ev as (  select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev,   min(created_at) first_entry, max(closed_at) settled  from paper_trades where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH')   and status='settled' and created_at > '2026-10-08' group by 1,2), s as (select event_ticker, min(close_time) close_t from mmsell_settlement_meta group by 1), c as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev,   min(captured_at + hours_to_expiration*interval '1 hour') exp_min,   max(captured_at + hours_to_expiration*interval '1 hour') exp_max, min(captured_at) first_tick  from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > '2026-10-07' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH') group by 1) select ev.ser, ev.ev, c.first_tick, ev.first_entry, c.exp_min, c.exp_max, s.close_t, ev.settled,  round((extract(epoch from (ev.settled - c.exp_min))/3600)::numeric,2) settle_minus_exp_h,  round((extract(epoch from (s.close_t - c.exp_min))/3600)::numeric,2) close_minus_exp_h from ev left join s on s.event_ticker=ev.ev left join c on c.ev=ev.ev order by random() limit 40
